name: cli-agent
notes: A wrapper: runs any prompt-taking agent CLI (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, ...) as the harness. Configure with HG_CLI / HG_CLI_ENV / HG_CLI_MODEL. See agent.py's docstring. `runtime_paths` names the trees a CLI lives in when it is not under /usr; this example points at a directory outside the platform holding tools/fake_cli.py's copy.
